notes: Customer: mid-market SaaS (product analytics for e-commerce retailers). Heavy embeddings use for product similarity + session-level semantic search.
Primary ask: replace current Pinecone workflow to reduce TCO and get better throughput. Wants 'one provider' that can scale from dev -> dedicated with same API.
Latency targets: P99 < 120ms at 1k qps baseline; stretch target 3k qps for peak windows. Cost sensitivity high — looking to reduce per-query unit cost vs hosted baseline.

Data topology: nightly batch job produces 50M 1536-dimension vectors (float16/quantized). Vectors + lightweight metadata stored in S3; currently use an in-house indexer that writes to Pinecone. Wants Redwood to integrate with existing S3 pipeline or host index on Dedicated nodes.
Quote from VP Product: 'We need predictable costs and something we can push to production without retooling our whole infra.'

POC requirements summarized: 1) VPC peering and private egress for S3 access, 2) bulk import tooling (multi-part, resume support), 3) throughput run at 3k qps sustained for 30 minutes, 4) metrics dashboard and token/cost breakdown during POC.
Security: will require SSO (SAML), KMS for key ops, and audit logs sent to their SIEM (Splunk). Data residency: US only for production tenants.

Integration notes: prefer server-side batch ingestion (Spark job) that writes ndjson of vectors to Redwood ingestion endpoint. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization + batching to hit cost targets.
Decision drivers: throughput proof, reserved pricing for Dedicated, security/compliance check, ease of migration (ingest tooling), support SLAs.

Internal AE notes: keep pricing options simple (monthly hosted comparison + 12mo reserved), escalate any dedicated infra limits to infra-team early. SE to prepare scripts for sample import and suggested batch sizes (256-1024 vectors).
